name: bond-beauty-crm
description: beauty-crm-only companion to bond. Enable it in the beauty-crm clone (.claude/settings.local.json), not globally. Ships implement (claim a task card, ask every question up front, build, done, pr) and batch (several tasks that share files closed in one pull request), both driving the repository's own `pnpm tasks` flow, and the questions-first rule they run under in place of bond's ask-nothing autonomy.
